export declare const GAP = 8;
// exported from this entry as "FLOATING_GAP"

export declare const MARGIN = 8;
// exported from this entry as "FLOATING_MARGIN"

export interface FloatingAnchor {
    left: number;
    top: number;
    bottom: number;
    right: number;
}

export type FloatingMode = "below" | "above" | "beside";

export interface FloatingSize {
    width: number;
    height: number;
}

export declare function clampTo(value: number, limit: number, length: number): number;

export declare function followScroll(panel: Element, run: () => void): () => void;

export declare function pick(preferred: number, alternate: number, preferredFits: boolean, alternateFits: boolean, preferredRoom: number, alternateRoom: number): number;
// exported from this entry as "pickSide"

export declare function pinAt(el: HTMLElement, left: number, top: number): void;

export declare function placeFloating(anchor: FloatingAnchor, size: FloatingSize, viewport: {
    width: number;
    height: number;
}, mode: FloatingMode): {
    left: number;
    top: number;
};

export declare function placeOverlay(el: HTMLElement, anchor: FloatingAnchor, mode: FloatingMode, stage?: string): void;

export declare function placeStacked(anchor: FloatingAnchor, size: FloatingSize, viewport: {
    width: number;
    height: number;
}, mode: "above" | "below"): {
    left: number;
    top: number;
};

export declare function scrollShouldFollow(target: EventTarget | null, panel: Element | null): boolean;
